lines.say: You need one pack of instant ramen, two big spoons of peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, garlic, and chili crisp.
lines.show: You need one pack of instant ramen, two big spoons of peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, garlic, and chili crisp.

lines.say: Whisk the peanut butter with soy, honey, and garlic. Then add a splash of hot noodle water.
lines.show: Whisk the peanut butter with soy, honey, and garlic. Then add a splash of hot noodle water.

lines.say: Watch it go from thick paste, to glossy and silky.
lines.show: Watch it go from thick paste, to glossy and silky.

lines.say: Boil the noodles for three minutes. Skip the seasoning packet. You won't need it.
lines.show: Boil the noodles for three minutes. Skip the seasoning packet. You won't need it.

lines.say: Drop them straight into the sauce, and toss until every single strand is coated.
lines.show: Drop them straight into the sauce, and toss until every single strand is coated.

lines.say: Top it with chili crisp, green onion, and crushed peanuts.
lines.show: Top it with chili crisp, green onion, and crushed peanuts.

lines.say: It's creamy, salty, a little sweet, and spicy. Basically a five minute satay noodle.
lines.show: It's creamy, salty, a little sweet, and spicy. Basically a 5-minute satay noodle.
